[2:25PM] #LekkiPeninsula #TrafficUpdate 

Lekki Roundabout to Lekki Peninsula Scheme 1 Gate: Traffic is flowing smoothly in both directions, with no delays reported.

Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge to Alexander Avenue: The route remains free of congestion, including the return trip.

Roads 13 & 14, UBA/Admiralty Road Traffic Light, and Zenith Junction Stretch: Movement is steady and unhindered in both directions.

Dome on Freedom Way, Itedo, and Car Wash Axis: These areas are currently free of traffic.

Prime Water to VFS, Ikate Gate to Ikate Roundabout: Traffic remains light and free-flowing in both directions.

Our officers are well-positioned at all designated choke points, and there are no reported obstructions at this time.
